arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_fraud_dollars FROM transactions t INNER JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Sums the amounts of transactions labelled as fraud and converts the cents total to dollars.
assumptions: Only transactions with a fraud label of 1 are counted; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Negative amounts are included in the sum as recorded, without treating them as refunds.
